aboutGame.title: What Is Diablo Unbound?
paragraphs: Diablo Unbound is an officially licensed cooperative tabletop dungeon battler developed by Glass Cannon Unplugged with Blizzard Entertainment. One to four players choose a hero, assemble a modular dungeon from tiles, monster families, and bosses, then work through a three-act campaign built for repeatable encounters.

Each dungeon follows an explore, fight, loot, and boss rhythm. Class decks and skill trees shape what a champion can do, randomized gear carries power from one level to the next, and Town Phases provide upgrades and respec decisions. The campaign spans nine dungeon levels, with Torment endgame battles following the main story and a Gamefound campaign planned for Q1 2027.

faq.title: Diablo Unbound FAQ
faq.description: Answers to common questions about Diablo Unbound, its tabletop campaign, and the Gamefound launch.

items.question: What is Diablo Unbound?
items.answer: Diablo Unbound is an officially licensed cooperative tabletop dungeon battler from Glass Cannon Unplugged and Blizzard Entertainment. It supports one to four players and combines class decks, dice-driven combat, modular dungeons, loot, and boss battles.

items.question: How many players can play Diablo Unbound?
items.answer: Diablo Unbound supports one to four players in fully cooperative play. Solo games use the same class and encounter systems, while larger parties divide frontline, damage, control, and support jobs.

items.question: Which classes are available in Diablo Unbound?
items.answer: The announced starting roster includes the Barbarian, Rogue, Sorceress, and Paladin. Each class has its own skill tree, ability set, and progression path, with more classes planned through stretch goals and expansions.

items.question: How long is a Diablo Unbound campaign?
items.answer: The main campaign spans three acts, each containing three dungeon levels and a boss. A single dungeon is designed to run about 60 to 90 minutes, with Town Phases between descents for upgrades, loot sorting, and respec decisions.

items.question: When is the Diablo Unbound Gamefound campaign?
items.answer: The Diablo Unbound Gamefound campaign is planned for Q1 2027. The official Glass Cannon Unplugged project page and Gamefound pre-launch page are the places to follow for campaign dates, pledge details, and stretch goals.
